case_study_title: Finance: Fast, Stable Convergence in Risk Modeling
case_study_desc: In studies conducted within QuevaTech, the effects of the AI-Hybrid TRNG approach on Monte Carlo simulations are being investigated. Our research documents the potential of high-quality randomness to increase convergence speed and reduce the margin of error in risk analysis and portfolio optimization processes with technical metrics.
gaming_case_study_title: Game Studios: Less Repetition, More Variety in Procedural Generation
gaming_case_study_desc: The effects of hardware-based true random number generators (TRNG) on procedural content generation (PCG) are being tested in a laboratory environment. Our study demonstrates the success of improving seed quality in minimizing pattern repetitions and maximizing content diversity with scientific data.
gaming_case_study_stat: Increase in Variation and Entropy Quality
security_case_study_title: Cybersecurity: Standards-Aligned Key and Session Randomness
security_case_study_desc: Our research on the integration of physical entropy sources into cryptographic key generation processes aims for compliance with NIST SP 800-90A/B/C standards. The study technically analyzes the superiority of hardware-based solutions over software approaches in session confidentiality and key security.
